name: blocks.system
description: A small, dependency-free browser system for individually addressable HTML, canvas and custom objects.

options.name: onIssue
options.doc: Called with a code and a message whenever blocks.system refuses or skips something without throwing: an unknown add() option, dock() on a pinned block, a hydrate() that finds nothing. Without it nothing is reported. Try onIssue: console.warn while building.

options.name: layout
options.doc: Choose one complete layout model. Defaults to free.

options.name: resizable
options.doc: Show resize lines in flow-grid. Defaults to false and is rejected in other layouts.

options.name: rowHeight
options.doc: Fixed row height in pixels; the field then follows its rows. Defaults to null: rows share the field height. Rejected in free layout.

options.name: dockPosition
options.doc: Where a filled dock rail lives: above (default) or below the grid.

options.name: variant
options.doc: Appearance for new blocks. Defaults to "regular"; "random" draws from the chance settings.

options.name: colorArray
options.doc: User-owned CSS colors available to future random blocks. Defaults to an empty array.

options.name: colorVariation
options.doc: Share of random blocks using colorArray. A positive value requires at least one color.

members.name: rows
members.doc: Current row count: the setGrid() minimum or more when the content needs it.

members.name: rowHeight
members.doc: Fixed row height in pixels, or null when rows share the field height.

members.name: dockPosition
members.doc: Read or move the dock rail: "top" (default) or "bottom".

members.name: colorArray
members.doc: User-owned CSS colors available to future random blocks.

members.name: colorVariation
members.doc: Share of random blocks using colorArray. A positive value requires at least one color.

members.name: registerAdapter
members.signature: registerAdapter(id: string, adapter: BlockAdapter, options?: RegisterOptions): BlocksSystem

members.name: list
members.signature: list(filters?: { query?: string; adapter?: string; medium?: string; category?: string }): Readonly<BlockDefinition>[]

members.name: block
members.doc: The live block with this id, or null. get() and list() return catalog definitions instead.

members.name: blocks
members.doc: Every live block in its current order, docked blocks at the place they return to.

members.name: blockOf
members.doc: The live block that contains this element, or null.

members.name: batch
members.doc: Run fn and publish everything it changes as one blocks:change of type "batch". The changes themselves happen at once. Returns what fn returns.

members.name: checkLayout
members.doc: Tell whether restoreLayout() would accept this snapshot, and which ids it would skip or append, without changing anything.

members.name: destroy
members.doc: Remove every block, release the field and undo hydrate() and bindSearch(): observers and listeners stop and a hydrated page gets its original HTML back. Publishes no events. The system can start again afterwards.

members.name: hydrate
members.signature: hydrate(target?: string | Element | BlocksHydrateOptions, options?: BlocksHydrateOptions): BlocksHydratedField | null
members.doc: Hydrate declarative HTML blocks in a field with responsive spans, auto-fit, deep-link resolution and optional visitor persistence. Without a target, the first [data-content-page] on the page is hydrated; an options object may take the place of the target.

members.name: resolveAddress
members.signature: resolveAddress(url?: string | URL, options?: BlocksAddressOptions): HTMLElement | null
members.doc: Undock, scroll to and mark the block named by ?block= or #hash in url (defaults to the current location).

members.name: bindSearch
members.signature: bindSearch(input: string | Element, options?: BlocksSearchOptions): boolean
members.doc: Bind diacritic-insensitive live filtering and relevance ranking to a search input and its items.

members.name: setGrid
members.doc: Fix the columns and set the minimum rows; rows grow and shrink with the content.

members.name: fitHeight
members.signature: fitHeight(ids?: Iterable<string>): ReadonlyArray<Readonly<{ id: string; columns: number; rows: number; changed: boolean }>>
members.doc: Fit every live block's row span to its rendered content at the current widths.

members.name: exportLayout
members.doc: Export content-free layout state in current DOM order.

members.name: restoreLayout
members.signature: restoreLayout(layout: BlocksLayout | { version: 1; layout: BlocksLayoutMode; blocks: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string } & Partial<BlocksLayoutEntry>> }, options?: BlocksRestoreOptions): BlocksSystem
members.doc: Restore known block order, spans (or keep current spans when omitted), optional fixed positions, minimized, docked and pinned state.

members.name: saveBaseline
members.doc: Make the current order, spans, places, minimized, docked and pinned state the target of reset(); blocks added later join at the end.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Return every block to the saved baseline (by default its add() order, span, place and initial minimized state, undocked and unpinned); publishes one "reset" change.

members.name: mount
members.signature: mount(id: string, target: string | Element, overrides?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Element>

members.name: remount
members.signature: remount(id: string, target: string | Element, overrides?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Element>

members.name: snippet
members.signature: snippet(id: string, overrides?: Record<string, unknown>): string

block.content: trusted HTML string, a DOM node, or a function returning either

options.name: title
options.doc: Optional visible menu title. When omitted, id remains an accessible fallback but is not rendered.

options.name: draggable
options.doc: Allow this block to move while the system remains draggable. Defaults to true.

options.name: span
options.doc: Initial span in whole grid units, applied like span(); rejected in free layout.

options.name: place
options.doc: Initial fixed-grid coordinates, applied like place().

options.name: summary
options.doc: Short content shown by the docked chip instead of the title alone; same trust boundary as content.

menu.name: dock
menu.doc: Show the reversible close-to-dock action. Defaults to true.

menu.name: copy
menu.doc: Show a button that copies the block's decoded visible text. Defaults to false.

menu.name: pin
menu.doc: Show the favorite toggle. A pinned block moves in front of the unpinned blocks and ignores dock(). Defaults to false.

members.name: title
members.doc: Read or change the titlebar text. Setting it keeps the buttons as they are; on a block without a titlebar it adds one with the default menu.

members.name: layout
members.signature: readonly layout: Readonly<{ span: readonly [columns: number, rows: number]; place: readonly [column: number, row: number] | null }>
members.doc: The current span and place of this block, as exportLayout() writes them.

members.name: pinned
members.doc: A pinned block moves in front of the unpinned blocks and ignores dock(); a docked block ignores pin().

members.name: menu
members.signature: menu(name: string, options?: boolean | BlockMenuOptions): BlockController

members.name: dock
members.doc: Move the block to or from the compact dock without deleting it.

members.name: pin
members.doc: Pin the block as a favorite, moving it in front of the unpinned blocks.

members.name: summary
members.doc: Set or remove (null) the short content the docked chip shows.

members.name: fitHeight
members.signature: fitHeight(): Readonly<{ columns: number; rows: number; changed: boolean }>
members.doc: Fit the row span to the block's rendered content at its current width.

members.name: describe
members.doc: Serialize this live block into a registerable definition for the built-in "html" adapter.

shape.name: grid
shape.signature: grid?: { columns: number; rows: number } | null
shape.doc: The grid the snapshot was made for; rows is the setGrid() minimum. null in free layout. Pass it on as restoreLayout(layout, { grid: layout.grid }) to switch the grid together with the blocks. Optional when you build a snapshot by hand.

entry.name: place
entry.signature: place: readonly [column: number, row: number] | null

restoreOptions.name: grid
restoreOptions.doc: Switch the grid together with the saved spans, e.g. at a responsive breakpoint. Nothing changes when the target grid has too few columns or a saved place overlaps a fixed block.

check.name: ok
check.doc: true when restoreLayout() would accept the snapshot.

check.name: code
check.doc: Error code of the refusal, or null.

check.name: unknownIds
check.doc: Ids in the snapshot that are not in the field; restoreLayout() skips them.

check.name: missingIds
check.doc: Ids in the field that are not in the snapshot; restoreLayout() appends them.

options.name: storage
options.doc: localStorage key prefix for the visitor's order, docked and pinned blocks; the page name follows it. false stores nothing. Defaults to "blocks.system:layout".

options.name: breakpoints
options.doc: Width modes for data-grid-{name}-columns/rows and data-block-span-{name}. Defaults to wide 1080, medium 680, compact 0.

options.name: fixedMediaSelector
options.doc: Blocks containing a match keep their span instead of fitting their content. Defaults to "[data-block-fixed-height]".

options.name: viewportLead
options.signature: viewportLead?: boolean | ((field: Element, source: Element) => boolean)
options.doc: Let the [data-block-role="lead"] block fill the viewport height.

options.name: address
options.doc: Call resolveAddress() after hydration. Defaults to true.

page.name: currentLayout
page.signature: currentLayout(): { mode: string; grid: { columns: number; rows: number }; blocks: readonly BlocksLayoutEntry[]; }

page.name: applyComposition
page.signature: applyComposition(pageLayout: { grid?: Record<string, { columns: number; rows: number }>; blocks?: Record<string, { span?: Record<string, readonly [number, number]> }>; } | null): void

addressOptions.name: queryKey
addressOptions.doc: Query parameter that names the block. Defaults to "block".

addressOptions.name: highlightDuration
addressOptions.doc: Milliseconds data-block-addressed stays on the block. Defaults to 2600.

searchOptions.name: root
searchOptions.doc: Where the input selector, items and status are looked up. Defaults to document.

searchOptions.name: status
searchOptions.doc: Element or selector that shows the hit count.

searchOptions.name: shortcut
searchOptions.doc: Key that focuses the input from anywhere on the page; false turns it off. Defaults to "/".

searchOptions.name: focus
searchOptions.doc: Value of ?focus= that focuses the input on load. Defaults to "search".

definition.name: url
definition.doc: Page the block lives on; address() prefers it over the system catalogUrl. Relative urls resolve against catalogUrl or the current page.

definition.name: markup
definition.doc: Trusted HTML for the built-in "html" adapter — the same trust boundary as add(content).

adapter.name: mount
adapter.signature: mount(context: BlockAdapterContext<TSettings>): Element | { node: Element } | Promise<Element | { node: Element }>

detail.name: changes
detail.doc: Only on type "batch": the events batch() held back.
